result.summary: The page is a food delivery app home screen that renders cleanly overall. Found a few minor layout and styling issues related to content truncation and inconsistent element styling.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in 'Fastest near you' (Trattoria Piccol...) is cut off at the right edge with truncated text, which may look like a broken layout rather than an intentional horizontal scroll indicator.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the partially visible card clearly indicates horizontal scrollability, or add a fade/gradient and consistent spacing so truncation appears intentional.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) icons are styled inconsistently: the Tokumaru Ramen card has an outlined heart on a white circle, while the pizza card below has an outlined heart on a dark circle.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite button background and icon styling across all restaurant cards for visual consistency.

issues.description: The category filter row (All, Pizza, Sushi, Burgers, Healthy) appears cut off at the right edge, suggesting more categories exist but the scroll affordance is unclear.
issues.suggestion: Add a visual cue (partial chip or fade) to indicate the category list is horizontally scrollable.
